patterns.name: Remote Desktop Interactive Logon (Event ID 4624, LogonType 10)
patterns.description: Surfaces successful Remote Desktop (RDP) logons including origin IP and user account.
patterns.cql: #repo = "windows-event-logs" EventID = 4624 LogonType = 10 | select([@timestamp, TargetUserName, TargetDomainName, IpAddress, WorkstationName])

patterns.name: New Local User Account Created (Event ID 4720)
patterns.description: Alerts when a new user account is created on a domain controller or workstation.

patterns.name: Process Creation with Suspicious Command Line Arguments (Event ID 4688)
patterns.description: Detects process execution referencing shadow copies, credential dumping, or bcdedit tampering.
patterns.cql: #repo = "windows-event-logs" EventID = 4688 CommandLine = /(vssadmin.*delete.*shadows|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled.*no|wbadmin.*delete.*catalog)/i | select([@timestamp, ComputerName, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine])
